newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait prince "excellent" after surgery - doctor.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait prince "excellent" after surgery - doctor.

text.p: Kuwait's Crown Prince and Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah is in excellent condition after colon surgery, the head of his medical team said on Saturday night.
Hilal Mesaed al-Sayer "stressed that the health condition of Sheikh Saad was stable and excellent after Saturday's operation," the official Kuwait News Agency (KUNA) reported.
Sheikh Saad, born 1930, was rushed to Emiri Hospital in Kuwait City on Tuesday after fainting due to internal bleeding. He was released on Thursday, but returned to hospital a day later.
"Underlining the importance of the element of time, Sayer said an operation was then deemed necessary to surgically remove a section of the intestine," KUNA added.
Several regional leaders, including Saudi Arabia's King Fahd, have telephoned Kuwait's Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah to inquire about the health of Sheikh Saad who is also prime minister.
